name: Герои Эхо недели Забытых — народ стоячих камней, отбивший «Нашествие безымянных» (ADR-0023, ADR-0024; docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Забытые — Безымянные»; RS.weeks в design/ui/roster.js). Пятеро по герою за цикл II–VI: c2-55 Брудд Стоячий, c3-48 Одлен Мох Камней, c4-49 Каррен Резец, c5-61 Сейлен Подъёмщица Камней, c6-50 Менвен Последнее Имя. Задание 30.09.2026: портреты для окон призыва и Эхо вместо инициалов. Рецепт — принятый отряд Иш-Кантуна (jobs/heroes-echo-ishkantun.json) и способ «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md); в рамке — нижний край режет фигуру по поясу, низ плавно уходит в тень без плашки. Раса — Забытые, облик ни на кого из нынешних не похож. Народ стоячих камней — решение агента по главам: крепкие, обветренные, квадратные лица, глаза бледного мха, кожа светлая с холодной серинкой, как лишайник на камне, волосы цвета сланца с серебром даже у молодых, тяжёлые косы; некрашеная шерсть, костяные булавки, бронзовые резцы, катки и верёвки. Имя на камне никогда не рисуется буквами: только тёмная выемка под мхом, либо его закрывают свет, ладонь или летящая крошка. Враги недели — Безымянные: гладкие каменные маски без черт, пустые щиты, плащи, тающие в туман (jobs/echo-nameless.json) — только угроза за правым краем. Класс — по оружию и действию, школа — по цвету света. Детали, которых нет в «кто он» и главах, — решение агента, по строке в source
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, heroic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes, no ogham notches, no rows of marks anywhere — not on stones, shields or clothing; no glyphs, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no dark band at the bottom, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; no empty eyes. The hero's face is alive and fully featured, never blank or masked.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame, whatever the pose. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they are; the pose carries weight and intent. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size, with a clear expression. The lower part of the picture sinks gradually into deeper shadow — no band, no plate, nothing written. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

The hero belongs to the people of the standing stones — a forgotten people who lived long before all the peoples of today, on windy moors of heather and mist. At birth each of them gets a stone in the circle with their name carved into it: while the name is on the stone, a person holds in the world like a boat on a rope. They look unlike any people living now: broad, strong and weathered, with square faces, strong brows, deep-set eyes of pale moss-green and wide straight mouths; their skin is pale with a faint cool grey tone, like lichen on stone, reddened by the wind; their hair is dark slate-grey streaked with silver even in the young, worn in heavy plaits. They wear cloaks of undyed wool in grey, brown and moss green pinned with bone pins, woollen tunics and leather belts; their tools are bronze chisels, wooden mallets, stone, rope and wooden rollers for raising stones. Their enemies were the Nameless — a people who gave up their names and went from circle to circle cutting the names off every stone: faceless stone-carriers, shadows with blank smooth shields and carvers with chisels, their faces smooth pale stone masks with no features, the hems of their grey cloaks fraying into mist; such things appear only as the threat beyond the right edge. A carved name is never shown as letters: it is only a deep shadowed hollow half-filled with moss, or it is hidden by light, by a hand or by flying stone chips.

jobs.title: Брудд Стоячий — Забытые, танк, Земля (c2-55, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c2-55: «Встал у круга камней с именами и не отошёл, пока Безымянные не ушли»; глава «Круг камней»: каждому при рождении ставят камень в круг с именем — держится, как лодка на верёвке; Безымянные пришли с севера с резцами; три дня били тени с пустыми щитами; на четвёртый ушли. Камень Брудда — девятый от входа (глава Каррена). Решение агента: гладкий пустой щит бьёт в дубовый щит справа; каменный молот в дальней руке; позади — его камень, имя скрыто мхом. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c2-55-brudd__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-55.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Brudd the Standing, a man of the standing stones, a defender of the Earth school. Who he is: the Nameless came from the north with their chisels and left clean circles behind them. He stood at his people's circle and did not step away: for three days the shadows with blank shields beat him while their carvers waited behind them. On the fourth day they left. Right now the shadows strike again. Character: immovable, grim and quietly contemptuous — whoever gives up his own name comes sooner or later for someone else's; his jaw clenched, his heavy brows lowered, his moss-green eyes steady and fixed on the enemy beyond the right edge. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he stands in front of the stone circle, turned toward the right, his shoulders driven forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm braces a round shield of heavy oak with a bronze boss toward the right, and a smooth, blank grey shield slams against it from the right edge; his far hand grips a stone-headed maul held low behind him. Amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from the peat under the blow. Details that tell his story: (1) the oak shield is dented and split from three days of blows; (2) his grey wool cloak is torn and pinned with a bone pin; (3) a bruised cheekbone and a split lip; (4) his plaits are streaked with silver, one of them come loose; (5) behind him stands his own tall stone, its carved name hidden under thick moss. Place: a stone circle on a misty moor at night, heather and peat, standing stones fading into the mist behind him. Amber light rises from the cracks of the peat and stone below; cold mist comes from the right.

jobs.title: Одлен Мох Камней — Забытые, лекарь, Земля (c3-48, Эхо, вневременная)
jobs.source: roster.js c3-48: «Лекарка народа камней, лечившая мхом с северной стороны стоячих камней. Говорила, что мох помнит больше, чем камень»; главы «Северный мох» (на палец за зиму; останавливает кровь, тянет жар, закрывает рану, как крышкой), «Что помнит мох» (снимала целым куском — на изнанке имя читалось, как оттиск; мох с камня клала на грудь, и человек вспоминал себя на вечер). Решение агента: протягивает вправо целый пласт мха, изнанка светится янтарём Земли (оттиска имени не видно); корзина со свёрнутыми пластами за спиной; пальцы зелёные до костяшек. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c3-48-odlen__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-48.jpg. v2: v1 статична — стоит с пластом мха на ладони; теперь шаг вперёд, мох прижимается к ране обеими руками
jobs.subject: Subject: Odlen Moss-of-the-Stones, a woman of the standing stones, a healer of the Earth school. Who she is: moss grows on the north side of the standing stones, a finger's width each winter, and it heals better than any herb — it stops blood, draws out fever and closes a wound like a lid. She peeled it off the stones in one piece, and laid the moss of a person's own stone on the chest of one whose name had been cut away, and they remembered themselves for an evening. Right now she lays a slab of moss on a wounded one. Character: wise, tender and unforgiving to the Nameless — a quiet, ancient dignity, a legend of her people; her face calm and grave, her moss-green eyes deep and kind. Pose, the moment of healing: the camera is low; she strides forward toward the right, her cloak and plaits swept back by the wind, and leans in over the wounded beyond the right edge. She has exactly two arms: both hands press forward toward the right a thick, whole slab of green moss peeled from a stone, as if laying it on a wound, and its underside flares with warm amber light of the Earth school that lights her face from below; a small bronze scraper hangs from a cord at her wrist. Motes of amber light rise from the moss like pollen. Details that tell her story: (1) a basket on her back is full of rolled slabs of moss; (2) her fingers are stained green to the knuckles; (3) the tall stone behind her has its north side half-stripped of moss; (4) her silver-streaked plaits are pinned with bone pins, a sprig of heather in them; (5) a long cloak of moss-green wool. Place: the stone circle on a moor at dusk, mist between the stones, heather, a small peat fire glowing warm. Amber light rises from the moss and the peat below.

jobs.title: Каррен Резец — Забытые, контроль (на контроль), Время (c4-49, Эхо, вневременная)
jobs.source: roster.js c4-49: «Резчик имён: вырезал имена обратно быстрее, чем Безымянные их срезали. Руки его не знали усталости, пока было что вырезать»; главы «Резец» (из чёрного камня, от учителя учителя; имя режут, чтобы читалось пальцами в темноте и к зиме в буквах взялся мох), «Срезанные имена», «Вырезать обратно» (резал по мху Одлен, глубже, чем было). Решение агента: миг удара киянкой по резцу — вспышка зелёного света Времени и летящая крошка полностью скрывают резьбу (букв нет); волна света к врагу за краем; пласт мха приколот к камню как образец. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c4-49-karren__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-49.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Karren the Chisel, a man of the standing stones, a carver of names and a controller of the Time school. Who he is: his chisel was of black stone, harder than any other; it came to him from his master, and to his master from his. A name is cut so that it can be read with the fingers in the dark, and so that by the next winter moss takes hold in it. The carvers of the Nameless cut names away until the stone was smooth, and a person forgot himself and walked after them; he carved the names back — deeper than before and faster than they could cut, and his hands knew no tiredness while there was something to carve. Right now he carves a name back into a stone as a Nameless carver comes near. Character: fierce, tireless and consumed by purpose — an old master; his brows knotted, his eyes blazing green, his mouth set hard. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands at a tall standing stone that rises at the right side of the picture, turned toward it and toward the right. He has exactly two arms: his far hand sets the black chisel against the stone, and his near hand swings a wooden mallet down onto it; at the strike, a burst of green light of the Time school and a spray of flying stone chips hide the carving completely, and a wave of green light spreads from the stone toward the enemy beyond the right edge, freezing the mist. Details that tell his story: (1) the chisel of black stone is worn smooth by three generations of hands; (2) a mallet of dark wood, its head split and bound with bronze; (3) thick forearms scarred by chips, grey stone dust in his brows and beard; (4) a slab of moss is pinned to the stone beside the strike as a pattern; (5) a heavy grey cloak thrown back from his shoulders. Place: the stone circle at night on the moor, mist rolling between the stones, the smooth blank stones of a ruined circle far away. Green light of the Time school bursts from the strike and rises from the ground below.

jobs.title: Сейлен Подъёмщица Камней — Забытые, физ ДД силы, Земля (c5-61, Эхо, первородная)
jobs.source: roster.js c5-61: «Ставила стоячие камни на место, когда Безымянные их валили, — и валила Безымянных. Один её камень стоит до сих пор»; главы «Поваленный камень» (плечи как у двоих; камни ставят всем родом на катках и верёвках, она — одна), «Подъём» (упором: подкапываешь, подкладываешь, толкаешь — по ладони за вдох), «Пустые щиты», «Камень, что стоит» (тени били её по спине пустыми щитами — не обернулась). Решение агента: миг подъёма — плечом вгоняет в вертикаль огромный наклонённый камень у правого края; рычаг в дальней руке; синяки от пустых щитов на спине. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c5-61-seilen__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c5-61.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Seilen Stone-Raiser, a woman of the standing stones, a warrior of great strength of the Earth school. Who she is: stones are raised into the circle by the whole clan, on rollers and ropes, but she raised them alone — her shoulders were as broad as two people's. When the Nameless were too lazy to cut the names, they toppled the stones face down, and a person began to forget himself; she raised them again, one a day, then two, and toppled the Nameless the same way — shoulder first, face into the earth. Right now she heaves a fallen stone upright while the shadows beat her back with blank shields. Character: enormously strong, stubborn and silent — the stone stands, and that is enough; her teeth gritted, the cords of her neck standing out, her moss-green eyes blazing with effort. Pose, the moment of the heave: the camera is low; she drives her near shoulder into a huge tilted standing stone at the right side of the picture, pushing it upright, her whole body straining forward and up. She has exactly two arms: her near arm is wrapped around the edge of the stone, the hand gripping its rough corner; her far hand pushes down on a thick wooden lever wedged under its base. The stone rises; amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from the earth under it, and clods and pebbles fly. Details that tell her story: (1) her shoulders are enormous, bare and scraped by stone; (2) ropes and a wooden roller lie at the foot of the stone; (3) dark bruises on her shoulder blades from the blank shields; (4) earth under her nails and on her forearms; (5) her silver-streaked plaits are tied back with a leather thong. Place: the stone circle on a misty moor at night, a toppled stone half-raised, smooth blank shields glinting in the mist beyond the right edge. Amber light rises from the earth below.

jobs.title: Менвен Последнее Имя — Забытые, маг ДД, Время (c6-50, Эхо, вневременная)
jobs.source: roster.js c6-50: «Последней из народа камней вырезала своё имя — и его не срезали. Кроме этого имени, от неё не осталось ничего»; главы «Камни с именами», «Безымянные», «Чистые камни» (училась держать резец за Карреном), «Своё имя» (резец Каррена носила с собой; вырезала своё имя заново, глубже), «Последнее имя» (последний резчик Безымянных поднял резец и опустил; она назвала павших вслух и своё имя последним). Решение агента: миг заклинания — чёрный резец Каррена как жезл, поток зелёного света Времени к Безымянному за краем; ладонь дальней руки закрывает её имя на камне целиком. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c6-50-menven__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-50.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Menven Last-Name, a woman of the standing stones, a battle mage of the Time school. Who she is: the last of the people of the stones. She followed the old carver and learned to hold his chisel; when he laid it down, she carried it. Every winter she re-cut the names in her circle so that moss would not fill them — and once she understood that there would be no one to re-cut her own name after her, and she carved it anew, herself, deeper than before. Many winters later the last carver of the Nameless came to her stone, raised his chisel — and lowered it. Right now she stands before her stone and names the fallen aloud. Character: proud, sorrowful and unbreakable — the last one, who has nothing left to leave but a name; her head high, her mouth open as she calls the names, her moss-green eyes blazing with green light. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; she stands before her own tall standing stone, turned toward the right. She has exactly two arms: her near arm is raised toward the right, and in her hand the old black chisel points at the enemy like a wand — a torrent of green light of the Time school pours from it toward the Nameless beyond the right edge; her far palm is pressed flat against her stone, covering her carved name completely. Details that tell her story: (1) the black stone chisel, worn smooth, inherited from her master; (2) her palm on the stone hides the name entirely; (3) her plaits are more silver than grey, pinned with bone pins; (4) a cloak of undyed grey wool pinned at the shoulder with a bone pin; (5) around her the stones of her circle stand in a ring, green with moss — all the others are gone. Place: the last stone circle with names on a wide moor at night, mist, the smooth blank stones of other circles far away. Green light of the Time school rises from the ground below and flows from the chisel.
